summary: Riff loudness fix verified. I measured all 30 riffs/*.mp3 and 32 riffs/guitar/*.mp3 with ffmpeg ebur128 and volumedetect. Integrated loudness ranges from -15.8 LUFS (gil.mp3) to -14.3 LUFS (several guitar licks), a spread of 1.5 LU. All files fall in the -16 to -13.5 window. Requested files: charlie-rundmc -15.0 LUFS (max -1.3 dB), charlie-drummajor -15.2 (max -0.2 dB), charlie-grad -14.4 (max -7.4), guitar/gl-01 -14.4 (max -5.8), stew -14.6 (max -5.9), chunk -15.3 (max -1.3). The two new files are no longer quiet (they were about -35 before). Over the preview URL, charlie-rundmc, charlie-drummajor and chunk.mp3 each return 200 audio/mpeg. In the Dressing Room, outfit-rundmc, outfit-drummajor and outfit-grad request riffs/charlie-rundmc.mp3, riffs/charlie-drummajor.mp3 and riffs/charlie-grad.mp3. avatar-pick-chunk requests riffs/chunk.mp3, not sfx-drum-fill. avatar-pick-charlie requests a random guitar lick (gl-03), as intended.

minor.issue: max_volume -0.2 dB is just above the -0.5 dB no-clipping target. All other files are at -1.2 dB or lower. Not audible clipping, but the limiter ceiling should be lowered (e.g. alimiter limit=0.89, or loudnorm TP=-1.5) for this file.

action_items: Optional: re-render charlie-drummajor.mp3 with a true-peak ceiling of about -1 dBTP (it peaks at -0.2 dB now)
critical_code_review_comments: avatarRiffs.js routing is correct. OUTFIT_RIFFS contains charlie-rundmc, charlie-drummajor and charlie-grad, and POOLS has no entries for them, so their dedicated files are used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loudness loop: for f in riffs/*.mp3 riffs/guitar/*.mp3 run ffmpeg ebur128 and volumedetect. Dressing Room overlays to dismiss in order: audio-unlock-overlay, player-name-skip (can appear twice), tour-start-modal-close. Use dispatch_event('click'), because the overlays block force clicks.
